Alessandro Bianchini wrote on 07/21/2009 08:35 AM:
> Hello it turns out to be that i was simply trying to access one user's
> shared memory (www-data) from another R instance run by another user --
> logging in as www-data solved the problem (this was done using the
> bigmemory package -- which is not available on windows -- making a
> windows port a little bit less useful...)
